root_cause.text: The listener migration path in inet_csk_listen_stop() fails to call sk_data_ready() on the new listener socket after moving the child request to its accept queue via inet_csk_reqsk_queue_add(), leaving poll()/epoll_wait()/blocking accept() waiters on the new listener unawakened.
root_cause.evidence: Commit message states, "the target listener gets a new accept-queue entry via inet_csk_reqsk_queue_add(), but that path never notifies the target listener's waiters." The patch adds READ_ONCE(nsk->sk_data_ready)(nsk) after a successful migration to fix this.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix missing RCU protection and data_ready invocation during TCP request socket migration in inet_csk_listen_stop.
intent_record.what: Added rcu_read_lock()/rcu_read_unlock() around inet_csk_reqsk_queue_add() handling and added a call to READ_ONCE(nsk->sk_data_ready)(nsk) inside the success branch.
intent_record.how: This change ensures proper RCU read-side synchronization during request socket migration and explicitly invokes the socket's data_ready callback when migration succeeds, which is necessary to wake up processes waiting on the new socket.

candidates.rationale: Performs the request socket migration to the new listener's accept queue but fails to invoke sk_data_ready() on the new listener, leaving poll/epoll/blocking accept waiters unawakened.

vuln_statements.explanation: This statement adds the child request to the new listener's accept queue but does not call sk_data_ready() on the new listener, leaving poll/epoll/blocking accept waiters unawakened.
